emails.subject: NGX-PD-201: Scheduling Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) #3 - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

I hope you are well.

I'm writing to schedule the next routine Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) for the NGX-PD-201 study at St. Mary's Neurological Institute. I am proposing a 2-day visit during the last week of November.

My available dates are:
- November 27-28
- November 29-30

Please let me know which of these dates would work best for you and Dr. Evans. 

Key activities for this visit will include 100% SDV for the first three participants enrolled in Part B, review of the ISF, and drug accountability. I have attached a draft agenda for your review.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

Alex Johnson
Clinical Research Associate
NeuroGenix Pharma
alex.johnson@neurogenixpharma.com

emails.subject: Re: NGX-PD-201: Scheduling Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) #3 - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for reaching out. The dates of November 29-30 work well for us.

The draft agenda looks good. For our planning purposes, can you confirm which Part B participants you will be focusing on for SDV?

Also, please let us know what you will need for EMR access. I will need to submit a request to our IT department at least one week in advance to set up your temporary credentials.

Thanks,

Maria Garcia
Study Coordinator
St. Mary's Neurological Institute

emails.subject: Re: NGX-PD-201: Scheduling Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) #3 - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi Maria,

Excellent, let's confirm the visit for November 29-30. I have booked my travel accordingly.

For the Part B SDV, we will review participants 105-012, 105-013, and 105-014.

Regarding EMR access, I will send my details in a separate, secure email for you to forward to IT. Thank you for arranging that.

Please let me know if you need anything else from my side to prepare.

Best,

Alex Johnson
Clinical Research Associate
NeuroGenix Pharma
alex.johnson@neurogenixpharma.com

emails.subject: Re: NGX-PD-201: Scheduling Interim Monitoring Visit (IMV) #3 - Site 105
emails.body:
Hi Alex,

Sounds good. I've blocked our calendars for Nov 29-30 and noted the participants for SDV.

One quick thing - Dr. Evans has requested to add a 30-minute meeting to the agenda on the first day to discuss the recruitment strategy for Part B. Would you be able to accommodate this?

If so, could you please send over an updated agenda reflecting this change?

Thanks,

Maria Garcia
Study Coordinator
St. Mary's Neurological Institute

description: An email thread initiated by Alex Johnson to the Study Coordinator at Site 105, 'St. Mary's Neurological Institute', to schedule the next routine interim monitoring visit. The thread includes a back-and-forth discussion to confirm dates, finalize the agenda including Source Data Verification (SDV) for the first few participants in Part B, and arrange for access to the site's Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
